title: E: scripts/batch_final.py runs final held-out sweeps through the Message Batches API
summary: autoresearch/batch.py: BatchQueue + AnthropicBatchLLM (backend 'anthropic-batch', --llm/--target-llm/spec 'anthropic-batch:model'); threads' calls are pooled into Message Batches, results mapped by custom_id. scripts/batch_final.py runs evaluate-design over all reports concurrently so stages share batches; refuses paid runs without --yes. E3b Petri audits stay in harness/petri (interactive).
